description: R2 (reject-redundant-call-borrows): overload sets identical after erasing a non-receiver parameter's mode {T,&T,&mut T} are definition-site errors — all FOUR ratified shapes as uniquely named sets (free T/&T, free &/&mut, method T/&T, method &/&mut), four distinct diagnostics so subset matching cannot alias them. Replaces the retired &-as-selector driver tests.
